profiles.notes: Classic cystic fibrosis is fully penetrant (penetrance 1.0). Pathogenic variants in CFTR cause progressive multisystem disease including obstructive lung disease, exocrine pancreatic insufficiency, and male infertility. ClinVar star threshold 2 (reviewed by expert panel or multiple submitters) is recommended to minimize false positives in carrier frequency calculations.

CFTR-related disorders (CFTR-RD) represent a spectrum of conditions with reduced penetrance (~3%) compared to classic CF. Includes congenital bilateral absence of the vas deferens (CBAVD), bronchiectasis, and pancreatitis. Often caused by combinations of severe and mild/variable CFTR variants. Penetrance is approximate and varies by condition and variant combination.
